turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to optimize the backup scripts for the new server. Do you have the stats on our current knowledge base size?
I can help with that. What specific metrics do you need?
Mainly the total fact count and directory structure. Last I checked, we had about 2,500 facts spread across 150 entity directories.
Got it. I'll note that baseline for the backup configuration.
Also, did the replacement fan for the rack arrive? It's making a weird humming noise.
I don't have real-time logistics data, but you can check the tracking number in your email.
Right, forgot I sent that. Anyway, 2,500 facts is the number to use for the allocation script.
Understood. The script will be configured for 2,500 facts.
Lloyd, quick sync before I update the documentation. The knowledge base has grown significantly since we last spoke.
Oh? How much larger is it now?
It's much bigger. We're up to approximately 11,000 facts across ~537 entity directories now. The density has changed too, averaging about 20 facts per entity.
Noted. That's a significant increase from the previous estimates.
Yeah, the ingestion pipeline is running faster than expected. Also, I finally fixed that bug in the frontend, the login page loads instantly now.
Great to hear the login issue is resolved.
Just keep in mind the new scale for any capacity planning we do. 11,000 is the new baseline.
I will use the updated scale for future planning tasks.
